verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own event-driven controls: budgets and spend limits with auto-enforced controls, per-transaction limits with procurement approval flows, and automated invoice approval and payment. These amount to configured rules that act on spend events, but there is no evidence of a general user-defined 'when event X, do action Y' rule builder. Webhooks only notify external systems, and Pipedream/Zapier automations run on third-party platforms, so neither is credited as Brex's own rule engine. Missing for 10: a documented native rule/workflow builder with configurable triggers and actions, coverage of event types beyond spend limits and approvals, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
